tools.name: ls
tools.description: List the files in a directory of the workspace, with sizes and dates.

path.description: Directory to list, relative to the workspace.

tools.name: cat
tools.description: Show the contents of a text file in the workspace.

path.description: File to show, relative to the workspace.

tools.name: grep
tools.description: Search text files in the workspace for lines matching a pattern; prints file:line:text.

pattern.description: Text or basic regular expression to search for.

path.description: File or directory to search, relative to the workspace.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find files in the workspace whose name matches a glob pattern such as *.c

name.description: File name glob pattern, e.g. *.py or README*

path.description: Directory to search in, relative to the workspace.
